'''Patla Soo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Caarite]], who worked for the [[Metatheran Cartel]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Soo had became the [[Operations Manager]] of [[Cartel Central]], the base of operations of the Cartel on [[Caarimon]]. When the [[Believers]] attempted to release a dangerous virus on Caarimon, a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]], who were investigating the plot, asked Soo some questions during the course of their investigations.<ref name="BotB" /> The agents were able to prevent the release of the virus and Soo attended a celebration that was held on [[Dorumaa]] to thank them. During the event, she made a speech where she expressed her gratitude to the agents.<ref name="PO">{{LivingForce|Paarty On!}}</ref>
